text_to_speech: Hello astronomers! The SkyWatcher AZ-EQ6 SynScan is a dual  use, equatorial and alt-azimuth mount that   you can use with your EAGLE and other PrimaLuceLab  devices to do astrophotography the way you prefer. Let’s see how! Let’s start with technical specifications. The SkyWatcher AZ-EQ6 SynScan is the mount  we recommend for medium-sized telescopes   like Schmidt-Cassegrain telescopes up to 9.25”,   Newtonians up to 10” or refractors up to 5”  since this mount has 20 kg payload capacity. And it’s still portable with a weight of  only 15 kg, plus a tripod weighing 7.5 kg. In the box you will also find 2  counterweights weighing 5kg each,   bringing the total weight  32.5 kg, fully assembled. The SkyWatcher AZ-EQ6 SynScan comes with the  tripod, the SynScan handpad for automatic GOTO   to the many objects in the included database, an  ST4 autoguide port, and illuminated polar scope. And one of the great features  of the SkyWatcher AZ-EQ6 SynScan   is that you can use it in equatorial mode  like a standard german equatorial mount   or you can convert it into  Alt-Azi mode in a very simple way. Just unlock the screws, rotate  the latitude setting knob   and lock the mount head in Alt-Azi mode. Not only this is great for visual use,   but thanks to dual encoders, you can move  the mount manually without losing alignment. SkyWatcher even includes a clamp that will allow  you to install a second telescope in parallel. The SkyWatcher AZ-EQ6 SynScan  provides very good tracking accuracy,   in fact I often see graphs with +/-  5 arcseconds native periodic error. And, if we remove these screws on the back panel,   we will find a belt drive transmission  that helps minimize the backlash. This is very important to  improve autoguide performance,   even if a small backlash remains since  this is not a fully belt driven design. Now, let’s see how we can even improve  upon the SkyWatcher AZ-EQ6 SynScan mount. Many of you have asked us for a better clamp for  your telescopes and that’s why we designed an   adapter to let you connect our PLUS clamp to the  AZ-EQ6 mount, by replacing the standard clamp. You can even replace the standard tripod  with our C82 pier, if you want to have   the mount permanently installed in the  field, for example on the concrete base. Next, how can you take control  of your mount remotely? That’s very simple when you have the  EAGLE connected to your telescope! First of all, the EAGLE is able to  distribute power to your AZ-EQ6 mount   by using the PL1000026 EAGLE-type cable. This allows you to power the mount  and remotely turn it on and off,   also by removing the power unit  required by the mount itself. Next, in order to remotely control the mount,   you simply connect the USB cable from the  mount handpad to the EAGLE’s USB port. You can even eliminate the handpand  by directly connecting the “Hand   control” port in the front panel to the  EAGLE’s USB port with an EQMOD USB cable! This way you can control the mount position  and alignment from any planetarium or   astrophotography software for Windows,  by using the SkyWatcher ASCOM drivers. This is how I connect our SkyWatcher AZ-EQ6  SynScan mount to PLAY or Sky Chart softwares! Now I want to show you something really unique. You can use the SkyWatcher AZ-EQ6  SynScan mount in Alt-Azi mode   not only for visual use but  also for deep-sky astrophotography! In fact, by adding the ARCO rotator with PLAY  astrophotography software, ARCO will automatically   de-rotate the field allowing you to perform  deep-sky astrophotography in the easiest way! This is how it works. With the SkyWatcher AZ-EQ6 SynScan in alt-azi  mode, you connect a USB cable directly from the   USB port of the mount head to the USB port  of your EAGLE or standard Windows computer. The telescope has to be pointed North (or South if  you’re in southern hemisphere) and to the horizon. Then turn on the mount and other devices  (like camera, focuser, etc.) and launch PLAY.   Connect to COM port of the SkyWatcher AZ-EQ6   SynScan and to the SESTO SENSO 2 or  ESATTO focusers with ARCO rotator. Make a GOTO to any of the  included database objects   and ARCO will automatically de-rotate your camera. By using this technology,  I have been able to record   this beautiful picture of the Orion Nebula  from my urban light polluted sky, with the   telescope you saw in this video and without any  autoguider, polar alignment or meridian flip. It has been so fast and easy! And one of the things I like the most about this  telescope setup with the SkyWatcher AZ-EQ6 SynScan   mount is that you can begin your astrophotography  journey in this easy way, and then add more   advanced features and softwares, or move to  equatorial mode when you have more experience! For more content that will help you  to explore the Universe like a pro,   subscribe to our channel and…. clear skies!

youtube_description: SkyWatcher AZ-EQ6 SynScan PRO is the dual-use (equatorial and alt-az) computerized mount with SynScan hand-pad, dual-axis motor drive, tripod, illuminated polar scope, encoders and belt drive. The SkyWatcher AZ-EQ6 mount offers 20 kg payload capacity, high precision tracking and low backlash in a still portable and affordable mount. Together with EAGLE control and power unit, ARCO rotator and PLAY software, you can use this mount with your telescope also for EQ or Alt-Az deep-sky astrophotography! And you can improve it by adding the PLUS Dovetail Clamp for AZ-EQ6 or the C82 pier for concrete base. Discover more in our website www.primalucelab.com
